ports.label: SDI 1-2

ports.label: 10G Ethernet (2110 IP)
ports.formats: 10GBASE-T; ST 2110-20 (IGMP v2/v3), -21, -30 (Level C), -40; bis 1080p60; 16 Kanäle Audio; PTP IEEE 1588-2008 / SMPTE ST 2059-1/-2

ports.label: Sync Out (Ref Out)
